builds.name: azmasm's build
builds.about: azmasm's fork of nxnative: Performance mode, the preparing screen, the run-time shaders taken from the dump. Fastest on M1 and M2 so far.

builds.name: nxnative
builds.about: Upstream nxnative with Hermit's overlay and key-2 settings: its own Switch 2 shader translator and shared terrain tiles (less memory). Suits M3 and newer.

builds.name: mkw-neo (low memory)
builds.about: MenAtCafe's nxnative port tuned to fit 8 GB (MIT): a race holds about 4 GB, 40-58 fps on a MacBook Neo, every course played. The build for Macs with 16 GB or less and for fanless MacBook Airs.

builds.name: No Lag Kart (1.8.0)
builds.about: kingbumi31's No Lag Kart (MIT): nxnative tuned for Mario Kart World 1.8.0 (update v917504), with 23 fixes and a 15,000-pipeline warm-up list. Its author measured 60 fps with 1 or 2 players and 30 with 4 on an M2 Pro with 16 GB, with almost no hitches; other Macs are not tested yet, and a smaller GPU may not hold those rates.

builds.name: Thijs2004's 1.8.0 version
builds.about: Thijs2004's nxnative port for Mario Kart World 1.8.0 (update v917504) (MIT): the other build here for a dump with the 1.8.0 update (unchanged since 6 November).

choose.why: Your dump has the 1.8.0 update: No Lag Kart plays it with almost no stutter (Thijs2004's 1.8.0 version is the other choice)
Your dump has the 1.8.0 update: Thijs2004's version plays it too
16 GB or less: mkw-neo holds a race in about 4 GB (the other builds need 11-20 GB)
MacBook Air: the lightest build keeps a fanless Mac cool and fast
Macs with 17-23 GB: nxnative's build needs much less memory than azmasm's (which grows past 20 GB in long sessions)
M3 and newer Macs run nxnative's shaders better
M1 and M2 Macs with 24 GB or more run azmasm's build faster (about 58 fps against 47 on an M1 Max)
